fusions.name: Anchored Ram
fusions.desc: Plants every other arm and drives one in, dealing 16 damage, stunning the target for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Planted Sweep
fusions.desc: Roots on the spot and sweeps every arm around, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 4 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Footing Fast
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your armour rises 8% while it lasts.

fusions.name: Held My Ground
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 30%, you root every arm and a ward worth 25% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
